args.prompt: Continue the same single-shot approach toward the same pirate ship in the violent night storm. The camera reaches close along the wet black hull while huge waves strike the vessel, ropes and rigging swing, torn sails strain in the wind, rain streaks diagonally, and dense spray and fog pass in front of the lens. Lightning must occur as brief separate flashes in changing parts of the sky, lighting the hull, lanterns, rigging and foam for only a moment before darkness returns. Preserve the same ship identity and photorealistic cinematic storm, continuous camera motion, no cut.
args.negative_prompt: static image, frozen wave, frozen rain, stationary ship, permanent lightning bolt, continuous glow, calm sea, daylight, cartoon, text, logo, watermark, duplicate ship, warped hull, broken rigging, camera teleport, sudden cut
